_why: Expansion cards a chassis slot can hold. Two kinds, kept apart on purpose: `generic` is the card TYPES a design can name before a product is chosen (an 8-channel mic input, a Dante card…) — configuration, not products, so they live here and are always offered; their ids are the ones older device blocks' slots name (slot.cardId). Real card PRODUCTS are BIM library parts (DATABASE.server.BIM, /api/bim) whose `class` is one of bim_classes, offered beside the generic types when the library holds any. A generic type is never imported into the library as if it were a product (doctrine: Refusal over fabrication).
